description: One accepted live-pool hydration job with exact private recovery receipt; no claim of completion or currently warm capacity.
notes: --wait observes this new job, never a previous submission. --timeout bounds observation, not pool lifespan. Local timeout/receipt errors never authorize replay; cancel_requested is not terminal cancellation. Use job-scheduler get-instance with the same scope, then separately correlated activation telemetry for readiness. Receipt/resource details must stay private.

query_examples.description: Keep the accepted job identity without resubmitting.
Separate acknowledgement, local persistence and retry permission.
